product_launches.description: Respan is launching a proactive AI observability platform featuring an automated evaluation agent that traces AI agent behavior, analyzes failures, and provides proactive alerts and recommendations.

overview_description.description: Respan delivers an automated evaluation agent that empowers teams to define success through metric-driven workflows, assess production agent performance, and initiate actions like prompt refinements, regression testing, and performance alerts in response to changes. The platform connects observability, evaluation, decision-making, and iteration within a single system. It is designed to analyze agent behavior, account for non-deterministic outputs, and adapt as agents evolve.

about_short_description.short_description: Respan is an AI observability platform that helps teams trace, evaluate, and monitor AI agent behavior and performance.

product.name: Respan
product.description: An AI observability and LLM engineering platform for tracing, monitoring, evaluating, and analyzing AI applications and agents in production.

product.name: Respan Gateway
product.description: An API gateway for routing AI requests across model providers through a unified endpoint, with caching, retries, fallback, rate controls, and usage management.

product.name: Prompt Management
product.description: Tools for creating, organizing, testing, versioning, and deploying prompts used by AI applications and agents.

product.name: Evaluations
product.description: Evaluation tools for measuring AI application and agent outputs with datasets, scores, automated evaluators, and human review workflows.
